Develop reports that allow users to explore relevant trends, investigate exceptions, and monitor performance. Review and improve existing reporting for accuracy, usability, consistency, and performance. Data Analysis and Business Understanding Write and optimize SQL queries to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from multiple datasets. Develop a thorough understanding of product workflows, business processes, and the relationships between source data and reported results. Identify trends, anomalies, and performance gaps, and communicate findings with relevant business context. Work with stakeholders to clarify ambiguous requirements and agree on consistent definitions for KPIs and business metrics. Investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and coordinate with data engineering and product teams to resolve issues. Collaborate with data engineers to ensure reporting datasets are complete, reliable, and structured for analytical use. Document metric definitions, calculations, data sources, assumptions, and reporting dependencies. Ownership and Stakeholder Communication Manage analytical assignments from requirement gathering through delivery and ongoing improvement. Communicate progress, dependencies, and issues proactively. Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Work independently while maintaining regular collaboration with US leadership and stakeholders. Essential Skills and Experience 5+ years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role. Direct, hands-on experience developing reports and dashboards in Omni , including creating or modifying reporting logic and validating results. Strong SQL proficiency, including complex joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, and query troubleshooting. Experience delivering reporting solutions from business requirements through development, validation, and stakeholder review. Sound understanding of data modeling, relational databases, and data warehousing concepts. Demonstrated ability to investigate data issues and translate analytical findings into clear business insights. Strong attention to detail and accountability for the accuracy of reporting outputs. Clear communication skills and experience working directly with business stakeholders. Ability to prioritize work, manage competing requirements, and deliver with minimal supervision. Availability to collaborate with US counterparts during designated collaboration hours. Preferred Skills and Exposure Snowflake: Experience querying warehouse data and working with datasets used for analytics and reporting. Fivetran: Familiarity with data ingestion pipelines, refresh schedules, and their impact on reporting availability and accuracy. Medallion architecture: Understanding of Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers and how data progresses into business-ready reporting datasets. Python: Experience supporting data analysis, validation, or repetitive-task automation. Git/GitHub: Familiarity with version control for SQL, analytical code, or related documentation. Experience supporting SaaS products, financial services, or the automotive Finance & Insurance (F&I) industry. Educational Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related discipline. Candidates with equivalent relevant professional experience will also be considered. What We Offer Direct collaboration with US leadership and experienced data and product teams. Ownership of reporting solutions that support business and product decisions. Opportunity to work with modern analytics and cloud data platforms. Exposure to the automotive F&I industry and SaaS product environment. Scope to contribute to reporting standards, data quality, and analytical practices. Application Requirements Please highlight your Omni development experience in your application, including: The types of reports or dashboards you personally developed. Your responsibilities in writing queries, defining reporting logic, and validating results. The business requirements addressed and how the reports were used. Candidates should be prepared to discuss a specific Omni reporting project and explain their individual contribution. Any examples shared must exclude confidential or proprietary information.
